source.section: PDF page 18, Schedule S Part B Line 20 (Bailey 'does not apply to retirement benefits paid to former teachers and state employees of other states and their political subdivisions'); PDF page 14, Lines 11, 14, 15

worked: Federal AGI = New York State pension 36,000.00 + interest 750.00 = 36,750.00. NC has no deduction for another state's government pension: Bailey (Line 20) excludes it expressly, and no other line covers it. Federal taxable income = 36,750.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction - 1 x 2,000.00 age 65 additional = 19,000.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). D-400 Line 6 federal AGI 36,750.00. Line 7 additions (Schedule S Part A) 0.00. Line 8 = Line 6 + Line 7 = 36,750.00. Line 9 deductions (Schedule S Part B) 0.00. Line 10 child deduction 0.00 (no qualifying children). Line 11 NC standard deduction (single) 12,750.00. Line 12a = Lines 9 + 10 + 11 = 12,750.00; Line 12b = Line 8 - Line 12a = 24,000.00. Line 14 NC taxable income (full-year resident) = 24,000.00. Line 15 tax = 24,000.00 x 0.0425 = 1,020.00. Line 16 credits 0.00; Line 17 income tax = 1,020.00.
